main_body: Round leaf canopy (rows 1-35) on a thin trunk (rows 36-43) with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: none as a distinct band; the canopy is a rounded organic mass with lighter greens toward the upper right and no separate horizontal top surface
evidence: The tree is an organic rounded canopy. Reading the middle column, rows 1-35 are mottled greens with no distinct top band, step or front face. The trunk below is a thin vertical element. It has no rim, no cap line and no flat band, so it is not a front-elevation hat. Organic shapes are not a rigid box with a top surface, but the canopy is a front-facing blob with only shading variation. Under the strict rule, no top band and no distinct front face are measurable, so the 3/4 construction cannot be confirmed.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens in clumpy patches, with a dark green edge instead of black, so the outline reads as material tone. Texture is present but more mottled and noisy than the references' defined leaf clumps with per-clump highlights. The trunk is a flat 3-tone brown with little bark texture, and the base grass patch is a nearly flat fill. The silhouette is a smooth oval, plainer than the reference trees' irregular crowns with visible branches and roots. Overall it is a bit thinner than the references.
